summary.text: Joe Mayes is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 106 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Jared Patterson.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he said his priorities are fully funding public schools, making living in Texas affordable and defending access to books.

paragraphs.text: Mayes advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
In his Ballotpedia survey, he said the voucher program approved by the 89th Texas Legislature is a move in the wrong direction and that Texas public dollars must fund Texas public schools.
He said affordability includes housing, food, transportation and health care, and that funding public schools is the policy area he is most passionate about.
